preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT source_ref_id FROM gov_issue_ticket WHERE UPPER(source_type) = 'QUALITY_RUN' AND source_ref_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_ref_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_quality_run_issue

changeSet.comment: Guarantee one issue ticket per quality run source identity
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_gov_issue_ticket_quality_run_source ON gov_issue_ticket (source_ref_id) WHERE UPPER(source_type) = 'QUALITY_RUN' AND source_ref_id IS NOT NULL
